function.name: create_codeblock
function.description: Create or replace the named site object. Existing content may be overwritten; read it first before preparing a replacement. Use update_text_object for exact local text edits.

name.description: Unique object name: 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, hyphens or periods. Existing names are upserted.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
